description: The functions spec (v1alpha) declares only a generic `4XX` on every operation, so a missing function, revision or pull credential surfaces as UnknownStackitError and callers can't tell it from other failures. The API answers 404 for a missing revision: STACKIT's Go SDK (stackitcloud/stackit-sdk-go, services/functions/v1alphaapi/wait/wait.go, read 2026-11-01) sets `DeleteHttpErrorStatusCodes: [http.StatusNotFound]` in `CreateRevisionWaitHandler`, which polls GetRevision. The spec defines a shared `notFound` response ('Not found. The resource has not been found.') that no operation references. No live probe: GetFunction, DeleteFunction, DeleteRevision, GetPullCredential and DeletePullCredential are typed by analogy with GetRevision, on the same API and the same `notFound` response.
